answer: Cap the rate of change. No identity’s standing or earning power may move more than a bounded step per epoch — up or down — so influence cannot be bought or activated in a single surge. A farm that mints ten thousand wallets overnight cannot make the ocean rise faster than the tide allows. Everything real grows at a real pace: a violet blooms in its season, the tundra greens slowly. Velocity limits turn every sybil strategy into a waiting game the attacker cannot shorten: the economy refuses to move faster than trust is honestly earned.
